description: The monthly report: up to 5 Hyperliquid traders per exposure level (prudent, equilibre, risque; advanced picks from any list), with what a copy at that level would have made and lost over 90 days. Paid plan (access: full): everything, names and addresses included. Free trial (access: preview): rank, type, the copy figures, the trader's 90-day and 6-month returns, win rate (rounded down) and profit factor; no names or addresses. yourCopy: the top 3 of each level copied together, by balance (simulated). market: the month's market. texts: the month's notes (preview: no names, addresses or per-leader notes). annex: the biggest returns and why they are not listed (preview: up to 3 reasons, no address). yourResults: this wallet's real figures for the month ({ ready: false } until a month of copying is closed). Published on the 1st of each month for the month just ended.
name: get_report
title: Monthly report
